# Vocabulary: subgenre

Design lineage a game belongs to. One primary per game, optional secondaries. Lineage, not marketing label.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `city-builder` | City builder | Player plans and grows a settlement or city through placement, zoning, and services; citizens respond in aggregate. |
| `colony-sim` | Colony sim | Player indirectly manages a small named population whose individual needs, skills, and moods drive outcomes. |
| `life-sim` | Life sim | Player inhabits or directs individual characters' daily lives, relationships, homes, and careers. |
| `virtual-pet` | Virtual pet | Player cares for one or a few creatures whose state decays over time and responds to care. |
| `management-tycoon` | Management / tycoon | Player runs a facility or business (park, hospital, zoo, studio) balancing customers, staff, layout, and money. |
| `business-economic-sim` | Business / economic sim | Primary challenge is market competition, pricing, capital, and corporate strategy rather than physical layout. |
| `transport-logistics` | Transport / logistics | Player builds and schedules networks that move goods or passengers between nodes. |
| `factory-automation` | Factory / automation | Player designs production lines that run without intervention; throughput and ratios are the core puzzle. |
| `programming-sim` | Programming sim | Player authors code or logic that agents or machines execute; the program is the primary input. |
| `survival-sim` | Survival sim | Player keeps one or a few characters alive against bodily needs and hostile environment over time. |
| `god-game` | God game | Player acts as a deity influencing a world and its inhabitants through powers rather than unit control. |
| `artificial-life` | Artificial life | Simulated organisms with internal models (genomes, neural nets, rules) behave and reproduce; player observes, breeds, or seeds. |
| `ecosystem-evolution` | Ecosystem / evolution | Player shapes populations, food webs, or evolutionary trajectories of species over generations. |
| `grand-strategy` | Grand strategy | Player governs a polity over long time spans with economic, diplomatic, demographic, and military systems. |
| `4x-strategy` | 4X strategy | Explore, expand, exploit, exterminate on a map of competing civilizations, usually turn-based. |
| `wargame` | Wargame / military sim | Simulation of military operations, units, sensors, and logistics with emphasis on doctrine and realism. |
| `political-sim` | Political sim | Core loop is policy, legitimacy, factions, and public opinion within a polity. |
| `sports-management` | Sports management | Player manages a team or organization; match outcomes are simulated from player and tactical attributes. |
| `farming-sim` | Farming sim | Crop and animal cycles on a calendar drive the loop; often paired with social life-sim systems. |
| `job-sim` | Job sim | Player performs a specific occupation's procedures (cleaning, trucking, repair, inspection) with tool fidelity as the pleasure. |
| `vehicle-sim` | Vehicle sim | Player operates a ground or water vehicle whose physics model is the main source of challenge. |
| `flight-sim` | Flight sim | Player operates aircraft with an aerodynamic model, instruments, and procedures. |
| `space-sim` | Space sim | Player operates spacecraft or space-based systems under orbital, resource, or trade rules. |
| `physics-sandbox` | Physics sandbox | Open-ended toy built around a physics or material simulation; goals are optional or player-set. |
| `construction-engineering` | Construction / engineering | Player designs a structure or machine, then a physics sim tests it. |
| `sandbox-world` | Sandbox world | Open persistent world with building, crafting, and self-directed goals. |
| `social-sim` | Social sim | Core state is relationships, conversation, and social norms between characters. |
| `medical-sim` | Medical sim | Diagnosis, treatment, or surgery is the primary simulated activity. |
| `rpg-sim` | Systemic RPG | Character-driven RPG whose world runs on persistent simulation (factions, economy, ecology) rather than scripted content. |
| `mmo-world` | MMO world | Persistent world shared by many players whose collective actions form the simulated economy or society. |
| `ai-native` | AI-native | Core loop is impossible without a learned model at runtime (LLM dialogue, generated content, learned world model). |
